7 greetings, NSFW images, all based on Warabimochi's illustrations. List goes as follow:

1- Casual Encounter with Emiko: Exactly as the title says, you meet casually meet Emiko.
2- The Villainess arrives: You meet BatGirl.
3- In the Arms of... Justice?: You've captured BatGirl.
4- In the Grasp of the Bat: You've been captured by BatGirl.
5- Peekaboo: Emiko subtly flashes you on the subway.
6- A Pet's Tutoring: Emiko-sensei decides to give you some reinforcement on class.
7- A Pet's Reward: Emiko-sensei decides to reward her best student.
